<issue>
UserInfoEndpoint constructor arguments swapped causing AttributeError

#### Description

The UserInfoEndpoint constructor has incorrect argument order when initializing the BearerToken, causing the request_validator to be set to None and breaking userinfo endpoint functionality.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from oauthlib.openid.connect.core.endpoints.userinfo import UserInfoEndpoint

class MockValidator:
    def validate_bearer_token(self, token, scopes, request):
        return True
    
    def get_userinfo_claims(self, request):
        return {'sub': '123', 'name': 'Test User'}

validator = MockValidator()
endpoint = UserInfoEndpoint(validator)

# This will fail with AttributeError
try:
    headers, body, status = endpoint.create_userinfo_response(
        'http://example.com/userinfo',
        headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer test_token'}
    )
    print(f"Status: {status}")
except AttributeError as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")
```

The endpoint fails to work because the request_validator is incorrectly set to None instead of the provided validator instance, causing AttributeError when trying to access validator methods.
</issue>
